$y = 2(x - a)^2 + b$

In the given equation, $a$ and $b$ are constants such that $a > 0$ and $b < 0$. Which of the following must be true about the graph of the equation in the $xy$-plane?

B. II only
C. I and II
D. Neither I nor II
